manifest.author: Dhun Commons
manifest.description: A three-party seasonal treasury and field kitchen for Dhun's landscape: private multisig proposals, DHN rewards for node uptime and field work, steward profiles with background and capability review, a whole-wallet assistant that answers in the app and on Signal, routing prompts through Xenia inference over Logos delivery, with local-only Ollama menu suggestions, guest-scaled sourcing and cost estimates, zero-waste steps, farm sourcing and a guarded long-life pantry, an Open-Meteo and Ventusky agronomy and conservation advisory for the five field zones, a deterministic eight-agent civic simulation that carries water, roads, agri, safety, waste and care work behind human gates, where the agents consult, pair, hand off and peer-check each other, and live LEZ testnet accounts. Kitchen inference never falls back to a remote provider.
manifest.name: dhun_commons
